policies.definition: The adopted Stage 3 emergent-boundary policy (Tree spec S3.8, S3.13). Its values were approved by owner decision in calculogic-validator#171; decisions not yet approved stay unresolved.

decisions.rationale: Not decidable as a share alone (calculogic-validator#162, #171). A candidate whose conclusion is not invariant under admissible completions stays incomplete and never yields a finding (S3.13.3).
The only tested value that reproduces every catalogue expectation (S3.9). Not profile-aware; profile-awareness is a deferred alternative (S3.13.1).
A single token carries no lexical specificity (S3.3); every catalogue case reaching the rule expects low-specificity. It can only prevent an opportunity, never create one.
Outer-only selection is supported by E22 but not adopted. Related complete opportunities yield no finding while this stays unresolved (S3.13.3, EL5).
Only the S3.5 point (E14, E15) is fixed; any further limit needs more catalogue cases.
The established S3.5 assignment. Mixed documentation stays unresolved (M0); concern-style and integration-adapter stay unmapped, so their candidates are incomplete (S3.13.1).
A necessary condition only: a grouping covering the whole directory separates nothing (S3.8). Not an organizational-quality standard.
